polityNote: Republic of Suriname. The ten districts of the decree Districtenindeling 1983 (S.B. 1983 no. 24), whose lines the 1987 Constitution (art. 160(2)) makes the district boundaries. The scope starts when that constitution entered into force (1987-10-30), because the sources disagree on when the 1983 decree took effect on the ground (statoids and nl.wikipedia say 1985) — the years 1983–1987 are not claimed. Ground claimed by Guyana (Tigri/New River triangle) or by France (between the Lawa and the Litani) lies only where the polity record places it in Suriname. (1) independent check 2026-10-06: NE atom areas against statoids 2012 areas — nine districts 0.81-1.08 (Paramaribo 147 vs 182 km2); Sipaliwini 112,058 vs 130,567 km2 because statoids counts the two claimed triangles.
